paragraphs.text: Gamma is a creature type introduced in Universes Beyond Marvel Super Heroes . It is used for creatures that are classified as Gamma Mutates in the Marvel Universe .

Gamma is a Marvel Universes Beyond crossover type. In the Marvel Universe , Mutants are born with the X-Gene , a genetic trait causing powers to manifest naturally (e.g., X-Men ), while Mutates are humans who gain powers from external sources like radiation, chemicals, or experiments.

In the comics and other works based on them, gamma mutates are beings mutated by gamma radiation . The first of these to be created was Bruce Banner, the Incredible Hulk , and many gamma mutates have similar superhuman powers to the Hulk; indeed, many have an origin directly tied to the Hulk, such as Jennifer Walters, She-Hulk , who gained her powers from a transfusion of the Hulk's blood. These powers include a transformation triggered by emotional agitation, superhuman strength, and a powerful healing factor, but can also bring on uncontrollable rage.

Since gamma mutates are not simply referred to as "Gammas" in the comics, Magic cards attempt to avoid directly doing so as well. For instance, Hulk's Thunderclap has behold a "Gamma creature" as an additional cost . While other spells with additional effects if you behold a creature (e.g. Piercing Exhale ) write out the additional ability as "if a [creature type] was beheld," Hulk's Thunderclap has the unwieldy "if this spell's additional cost was paid" instead. This formatting is only used on the designed-for-digital card Territorial Strike ( Alchemy: Tarkir ), which requires that a creature card is beheld (as opposed to e.g. a kindred spell) because it interacts with that card's power and toughness.
